figures.public_caption: Solution photoluminescence and absorption spectra compare QD1–QD4, with dashed curves denoting the corresponding cores before shell growth. Further panels compare photoluminescence quantum yield and core–shell band alignment. UPS supplies the valence-band positions; conduction-band positions are derived using optical gaps and an assumed ZnSe-shell gap.

general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
